author: Komorebi P.

entries.title: Exact arithmetic packet reconstruction
entries.scope: Coefficient selectors over finite residue classes, idempotence, orthogonality, exact reconstruction and divisor refinement. Formal power-series versions use actual coefficients. Labels range over standard residues; modulus is positive for reconstruction. No new analytic convergence assertion.

entries.title: Unit EGF coordinate change
entries.scope: Actual exponential-series encode/decode over a characteristic-zero field. The inverse power series is constructed from constant coefficient one. Binomial convolution, inverse identities and conjugated packet laws are proved. The statement is formal/coefficientwise, not a separate analytic convergence theorem.

entries.title: Filtered triangular reconstruction
entries.scope: Finite coefficient-row divisibility over an arbitrary commutative ring, specialized to actual p-adic integers. Weights are natural numbers or infinity, with infinity denoting a zero coefficient. This proves the omitted-tail assertion. Weight growth is not needed for an individual finite row; no infinite-limit convergence theorem is claimed.

entries.title: Triangular congruential inverse
entries.scope: Rational coefficients constructed by well-founded forward substitution, nonzero binomial diagonal proved, unique solution proved. The reciprocal-series identity and actual original exponential-section product are proved using power-series expansion. For the original source formula, N>0 and 0<=j<N are explicit.

entries.title: Universal denominator clearing
entries.scope: The product of the binomial diagonal entries clears every constructed rational coefficient. The proof derives denominator divisibility through a general integer triangular system; it does not assume integral packet coefficients.

entries.title: Sharp normalization boundary
entries.scope: Exact coefficients from the general recurrence, valid parameter tuple, actual nonzero rational 3-adic valuation, sharp factorial-loss equality and explicit negation of the universal one-step no-loss claim. Also proves the corresponding unnormalized difference has valuation one. The general corrected finite-difference bound remains pending.
